This is the primary driver of reduced relevance — the outbreak investigation page may describe an event outside the target window entirely, or may contain retrospective case data that partially overlaps. The contradiction between `official_public_health_authority` and `secondary_news_or_media_source` flags — both present simultaneously — indicates a classification conflict that warrants LLM review.
